mona_aboutus_descriptions.title: About Us
mona_aboutus_descriptions.description:
Adtek is a growth marketing agency in Ho Chi Minh City, founded on May 5, 2022. We help brands grow from brand building to revenue through Brand Commerce, performance advertising, SEO and AI Search, data and CRM, and e-commerce.

Every engagement starts with understanding the client's market and business problem. We then combine creative work with data to build the strategy, run it and measure the results.

Legal entity: Adtek Technology Joint Stock Company, tax code 0317120810.
